decisions.reason: The commission trigger, recipient, destination, timing, and cap do not change the existing coded-referral ticket counts or recipient; immediate issuance on a referral mint was already established.
The source modifies commissions for mints using a referral code and does not alter ticket allocation when no referral code is used.
Commission payout semantics do not change the token-serial referral identity or its display locations, which are already covered by the candidate's same-message Event.
The commission modification does not change metadata fields; the source's separate referral-code metadata instruction is already represented by a same-message MODIFY.
The commission allocation and payout rules do not alter book access, referral identity, badges, or expired-ticket behavior after NFT transfer.
The candidate already records the $10 per-mint affiliate allocation; the source adds commission-specific trigger and payout semantics without changing the mint price or revenue amounts.
The candidate's same-message INTRODUCE already requires loading the complete supplied FAQ copy, including the commission language.
Automatic commission transfer is distinct from the manual one-click claim flow for prize winnings and does not change that flow.
Referral commission payout semantics do not change the Transak provider, supported fiat methods, conversion asset, or buyer wallet requirements.
The commission modification does not change badge thresholds, award basis, or on-chain attachment.
The commission trigger and payout rules do not change the Small Block winner count, prize amount, eligibility, pool trigger, or royalty contribution.
Requiring a wallet as the destination for affiliate commissions does not change the email magic-link authentication method or its dashboard-access scope.
